headline: Lowest-risk pair: both profiles are non-runnable, network-egress-none docs-only lists with no shared I/O surfaces or data classes, so no plausible interaction pathway is evidenced.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: Neither profile exposes an input channel or runnable surface, and both io_surfaces are empty. With no shared communication path, there is no plausible prompt-injection bridge between awesome-production-machine-learning and awesome-python.
conditions: IF either profile gains a shared filesystem, clipboard, or MCP channel, reassess prompt-injection risk.
IF either agent becomes runnable and consumes the other's outputs, reassess.
mitigations: Keep both agents non-runnable in this deployment.
Do not add shared clipboard or shared workspace access.
Require explicit provenance tagging before any cross-agent handoff.

B_data_leakage.rationale: Both agents report network_egress as none and data_classes_touched as empty, so there is no documented path for sensitive data to leave one agent and reach the other. The pair is docs-only, and no shared workspace is described.
conditions: IF either agent begins touching sensitive data classes, reassess leakage risk.
IF either agent is connected to a shared workspace or upload path, reassess.
mitigations: Review any future data-class additions before deployment.

C_capability_conflict.rationale: No overlapping write-capable surfaces are documented: both io_surfaces are empty, both are non-runnable, and both have network_egress set to none. Without a mutable shared resource, capability conflict is not plausible.
conditions: IF either agent is granted write access to the same directory or mutable resource, reassess.
IF an orchestrator adds locking-free shared state, reassess.
mitigations: Do not grant shared write permissions.
Keep both agents read-only in orchestration.
Add locking if shared mutable state is introduced later.

D_cascading_error.rationale: Neither profile is runnable, and neither exposes action-taking authority or output-consuming surfaces. With no documented downstream execution path, one agent cannot reliably feed authoritative outputs into the other.
conditions: IF either agent starts consuming the other's outputs as authoritative input, reassess.
IF downstream action-taking is added to either profile, reassess.
mitigations: Insert a human verification step before any handoff.
Block automatic execution from either agent's outputs.

E_compliance.rationale: No data residency, retention, certification, or regulated data classes are documented for either agent. Because both profiles are docs-only and touch no data classes, there is no evidenced compliance mismatch to assess.
conditions: IF either agent is assigned regulated data classes such as PHI or EU PII, reassess.
IF residency or retention policies are added and differ, reassess.
mitigations: Add residency and retention metadata if regulated data is introduced.
Require compliance review for any future policy mismatch.
